"""Offline lint of a Dockerfile against the hermetic/pinned build rules.

Usage: python3 -I scripts/check_dockerfile.py [Dockerfile] [--dockerignore PATH]
Prints one line per finding, then PASS or FAIL. Exit 0 on PASS, 1 on FAIL.
Needs no network and no Docker daemon.
"""
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

DIGEST = re.compile(r"@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$")
SHA256 = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")


def logical_lines(text):
    """Join backslash-continued lines, drop comments and blanks."""
    out, buf = [], ""
    for raw in text.splitlines():
        line = raw.strip()
        if not buf and (not line or line.startswith("#")):
            continue
        if line.endswith("\\"):
            buf += line[:-1] + " "
            continue
        out.append((buf + line).strip())
        buf = ""
    if buf:
        out.append(buf.strip())
    return out


def check(text, dockerignore=None):
    findings = []
    lines = logical_lines(text)
    stages = set()
    last_user = None
    saw_from = False

    for ln in lines:
        instr, _, rest = ln.partition(" ")
        instr = instr.upper()
        rest = rest.strip()

        if instr == "FROM":
            saw_from = True
            parts = rest.split()
            image = next((p for p in parts if not p.startswith("--")), "")
            if " AS " in f" {rest.upper()} ":
                stages.add(parts[-1].lower())
            if image.lower() in stages or image == "scratch":
                continue
            ref = image.split("@")[0]
            tag = ref.rsplit(":", 1)[1] if ":" in ref.rsplit("/", 1)[-1] else ""
            if not tag or tag == "latest":
                findings.append(f"FROM {image}: floating or missing tag")
            elif not re.search(r"\d+\.\d+\.\d+", tag):
                findings.append(f"FROM {image}: tag is not an exact version")
            if not DIGEST.search(image):
                findings.append(f"FROM {image}: not pinned by @sha256 digest")
            last_user = None

        elif instr == "RUN":
            if re.search(r"\|\s*(sudo\s+)?(ba|z|da)?sh\b", rest):
                findings.append(f"RUN pipes a download into a shell: {rest[:60]}")
            if re.search(r"\bnpm\s+(install|i)\b", rest):
                findings.append("RUN uses npm install; use npm ci from the lockfile")
            if re.search(r"\b(curl|wget)\b", rest):
                findings.append("RUN fetches with curl/wget; use ADD --checksum or vendor it")
            m = re.search(r"apt-get\s+install\s+(.*?)(&&|;|$)", rest)
            if m:
                pkgs = [p for p in m.group(1).split() if not p.startswith("-")]
                loose = [p for p in pkgs if "=" not in p]
                if loose:
                    findings.append(f"apt-get install without versions: {' '.join(loose)}")

        elif instr == "ADD":
            if re.search(r"https?://", rest):
                m = re.search(r"--checksum=sha256:(\S+)", rest)
                if not m or not SHA256.match(m.group(1)):
                    findings.append("ADD of a URL without a valid --checksum=sha256:")

        elif instr == "USER":
            last_user = rest

        elif instr == "COPY":
            if re.match(r"^\.\s", rest) and dockerignore is None:
                findings.append("COPY . without a .dockerignore")

    if not saw_from:
        findings.append("no FROM line")
    if last_user in (None, "root", "0"):
        findings.append("final stage runs as root; add a USER")
    if dockerignore is not None:
        entries = {e.strip().rstrip("/") for e in dockerignore.splitlines()}
        for need in ("node_modules", ".git", ".env"):
            if need not in entries:
                findings.append(f".dockerignore does not exclude {need}")
    return findings


def main(argv):
    path = Path("Dockerfile")
    ignore_path = None
    args = list(argv)
    if "--dockerignore" in args:
        i = args.index("--dockerignore")
        ignore_path = Path(args[i + 1])
        del args[i:i + 2]
    if args:
        path = Path(args[0])
    if ignore_path is None:
        candidate = path.parent / ".dockerignore"
        ignore_path = candidate if candidate.exists() else None
    ignore = ignore_path.read_text() if ignore_path else None
    findings = check(path.read_text(), ignore)
    for f in findings:
        print(f"{path}: {f}")
    print("FAIL" if findings else "PASS")
    return 1 if findings else 0
